title: Domestic Bank Account
description: A Domestic Bank Account structure extending the base account.

accountName.description: Name of the account as known by the financial institution operating the account.

sortCode.description: The UK Sorting Code identifier the sort code is xx xx xx.

bsb.description: An Australian/New Zealand term for the Bank State Branch indicator. It is a 6 digit value constructed with the first 2 digits identifying the bank.

routingTransitNumber.description: Routing transit number for the bank account. A routing transit number is a nine-digit number used to identify a bank or financial institution when clearing funds or processing checks. Established by the American Bankers Association (ABA).

accountNumberType.description:
The type of the `accountNumber` which asserts the format of the number:
 - `BANKGIRIT`: Up to 9 characters (example: 123-4567 or 1234-5678)
 - `PLUSGIROT`: Up to 24 characters; starts with "SE50"
 - `DEFAULT`: Format-less value
